profile.overview: Panda (and Kuma, often just referred to as bears) is an oddball character specializing in ranged poking and whiff punishment.
strengths: Hits Like a Bear: Massive range and damage which allows for easy, punishing sequences.
Disruptive: Possesses an i10 CH launch to keep opponents on their toes.
Bear Essentials: Wonky hurtbox makes her much harder to hit with lows and gives her surprising evasion with HBS and moves like WR1+2.
Circus Tricks: Can be tricky to play against with a plethora of strings.

Run. Unapologetically strong in Heat, dealing loads of chip damage with nearly uncontestable pressure; gains free pressure with Shooting Star, Heat Smash on block can go into either stance, and So Shoe Me is an unbreakable throw that switches sides. She can even hellsweep with H.db4,1 to floor break and have decent oki.
weaknesses: Massive: Wonky hurtbox makes her more susceptible to unique, higher damage combos for nearly the entire cast, as well as making evading moves harder.
One-trick Bear: Somewhat hinges on players not knowing Panda's strings very well, requiring stronger fundamentals once defensive counterplay is established.
Physics-defying: Several launch punishable moves, including most of her lows and some of her key moves.
Slows: Her strong lows are also slow, making them unusable on savvy opponents.

Not Kuma: Heat Smash isn't as fast or long ranged as Kuma's, and Shooting Star is prone to getting floated or stepped without a proper entry. Though subtle, she also has slightly less range than Kuma due to being marginally smaller, while still suffering all of the same issues of being a big target.
heat: Shortens charge time of hold attacks
Allows use of Panda Shooting Star and So Shoe Me
